title: Pool shoreline contact
duration_policy: shortest actually supported; API minimum 1s verified 2026-09-16, website minimum not assumed
must_move: one small painted water lap touches the existing shoreline stones and recedes
must_not_move: stones, rope posts, rope, plants, path and camera
end_state: the lap recedes to the original waterline
negative_constraints: no moving stones, rising water level, foam piles, new reflections or camera motion
runtime_contract: Short authored shoreline overlay behind stone cutouts, with fixed contact mask; fallback to tiny ring response. No opaque video rectangle.
first_frame_review: DRAFT: candidate painting and crop unaccepted
interface_contract: Single-image I2V uploads IMAGE_1 only; IMAGE_2 is operator reference unless selected multi-reference interface demonstrably preserves first-frame lock. Preserve input aspect; do not force 16:9. Request lowest sufficient supported resolution; returned native size/fps recorded separately.
requested_resolution: 480p initial motion study; actual returned dimensions must be recorded
